title: (RHBA-2016:2095) Red Hat Middleware Images for OpenShift
portal_summary: Updates are now available for Red Hat Middleware images running in OpenShift Enterprise 3.2 and OpenShift Container Platform 3.3.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat Middleware Images for OpenShift
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.3|x86_64
portal_solution:
To update to the latest xPaaS images run the following steps to pull in the content:

1. On your master host(s), ensure you are logged into the CLI as a cluster administrator or user that has project administrator access to the global "openshift" project. For example:

$ oc login -u system:admin

Then, run the following command to update the core set of OpenShift image streams in the "openshift" project:

$ for is in jboss-eap70-openshift \
   jboss-eap64-openshift \
   jboss-datagrid65-openshift \
   jboss-amq-62 \
   jboss-decisionserver63-openshift \
   jboss-processserver63-openshift \
   jboss-webserver30-tomcat7-openshift \
   jboss-webserver30-tomcat8-openshift \
   redhat-sso70-openshift \
   fis-karaf-openshift \
   fis-java-openshift ;
 do
   oc -n openshift import-image ${is}
 done
portal_description:
Red Hat xPaaS provides images for many of the Red Hat Middleware products for use within the OpenShift Enterprise 3.2 and OpenShift Container Platform 3.3 cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) for on-premise or private cloud deployments.

The images have been rebuilt using the latest OpenJDK 8 release.  These rebuilt images inherit all bug fixes and improvements currently included in the latest OpenJDK 8 release.

No other changes have been made to any of the Middleware Products included in these images.

This update includes following images:

jboss-amq-6/amq62-openshift:1.3-8
jboss-datagrid-6/datagrid65-openshift:1.2-25
jboss-decisionserver-6/decisionserver63-openshift:1.3-16
jboss-eap-7/eap70-openshift:1.4-14
jboss-eap-6/eap64-openshift:1.4-22
jboss-fuse-6/fis-karaf-openshift:1.0-15
jboss-fuse-6/fis-java-openshift:1.0-15
jboss-processserver-6/processserver63-openshift:1.3-18
jboss-webserver-3/webserver30-tomcat7-openshift:1.2-22
jboss-webserver-3/webserver30-tomcat8-openshift:1.2-18
redhat-sso-7/sso70-openshift:1.3-21
